name: My puppy: Yellow Labrador
summary: Welcome your sunny Yellow Labrador into your mixed reality home! Always cheerful and full of energy, this golden pup loves to play and be loved. Feed it tasty biscuits and chicken legs, toss a ball or toy bone, and watch it bounce with excitement. When it’s time to rest, gently pet its soft head or rub its belly—it’ll melt into your touch. Every moment together shines with happiness and warmth. Bring home the joy of a Yellow Labrador and fill your space with lighthearted fun!
